info.title: Sina Finance Web Quote API
info.description: Provider-owned but undocumented Sina Finance market-data URLs observed in public pages and reproducible read-only requests. Responses are JavaScript assignment/JSONP-like wire formats rather than JSON APIs, field contracts are not formally versioned, and consumers must decode the declared Chinese charset before parsing.

get.summary: Get single or batch quote snapshots
get.description: Return one JavaScript variable assignment per requested symbol. Verified on 2026-08-10 with the provider-required Finance referer. The response declares `application/javascript; charset=GB18030`; each quoted value is a comma-separated positional record, not JSON. For an A-share equity, the observed conventional order is name, open, previous close, last, high, low, bid, ask, volume, amount, five bid price/size pairs, five ask price/size pairs, date, time, and status. This field mapping is inferred from values rather than formal documentation. Index records can leave order-book positions zero, so clients must preserve empty/trailing fields and avoid assuming every instrument has the equity layout.

parameters.name: symbols
parameters.description: Comma-separated Sina identifiers. Observed A-share prefixes are `sh` (Shanghai) and `sz` (Shenzhen), followed by six digits; mixed-instrument batches may have different positional record semantics.

200.description: JavaScript assignments encoded as GB18030. Decode bytes before interpreting Chinese names, then split assignments and positional records carefully.

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Reproduced on 2026-08-10 with a Sina Finance Referer. Undocumented positional fields and instrument-specific layouts may change without notice; response bytes declare GB18030.

get.description: Return recent A-share bars wrapped in provider JavaScript (`var _data=(...);`) and preceded by a script-comment redirect guard. This is not bare JSON. Read-only requests on 2026-08-10 reproduced scales 1, 5, 15, 30, 60, and 240. Intraday records included day, OHLC, volume, and amount; scale 240 produced date-only daily records and omitted amount in the observed sample. Numeric values are commonly serialized as strings.

parameters.name: symbol
parameters.description: Single prefixed A-share symbol (`sh` or `sz` plus six digits).

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Observed bar scale. Values 1–60 returned intraday timestamps; 240 returned daily date labels in the 2026-08-10 sample. The provider does not publish a stability guarantee for this enum.

parameters.name: ma
parameters.description: Observed moving-average selector. `no` returns no MA fields; a numeric string such as `5` adds fields such as `ma_price5` and `ma_volume5`. Other combinations are undocumented, so this is not constrained as a closed enum.

parameters.name: datalen
parameters.description: Requested maximum number of most-recent bars. Positive integers are observed; the provider may enforce an undocumented cap.

200.description: GBK-declared JavaScript wrapper containing an array of bar objects; not bare JSON.

get.x-pontx-stability-note: Reproduced on 2026-08-10 for scales 1/5/15/30/60/240. The undocumented JavaScript wrapper, optional fields, numeric-string encoding, and scale semantics may change without notice.

QuoteAssignmentWireText.title: QuoteAssignmentWireText
QuoteAssignmentWireText.description: Raw GB18030-decoded wire text containing one `var hq_str_<symbol>="...";` assignment per symbol. This is JavaScript source text, not JSON. Do not execute it. Extract only the quoted assignment value, preserve empty/trailing comma fields, then map positions with the separately documented logical schema.

EquityQuotePositionalRecord.title: EquityQuotePositionalRecord
EquityQuotePositionalRecord.description: Logical model after safely parsing one A-share equity assignment. It is not the HTTP wire shape. Positions are zero-based comma-field indexes inferred by comparing live Sina quote-page values on 2026-08-10; Sina does not publish this contract. Do not apply it to indexes or other instrument classes without validation.

bid.description: Observed aggregate/current bid field; exact provider terminology is undocumented.

ask.description: Observed aggregate/current ask field; exact provider terminology is undocumented.

volume.description: Observed cumulative traded shares for the A-share sample.

amount.description: Observed cumulative traded amount in CNY for the A-share sample.

bidLevels.description: Five logical bid levels parsed from alternating size/price fields at zero-based positions 10–19.

askLevels.description: Five logical ask levels parsed from alternating size/price fields at zero-based positions 20–29.

unmappedFields.description: All remaining positions, including status/trailing fields. Preserve verbatim because their meaning is not confirmed.

KLineAssignmentWireText.title: KLineAssignmentWireText
KLineAssignmentWireText.description: Raw GBK-decoded JavaScript text: a redirect-guard comment followed by `var _data=([<objects>]);`. It is not JSON on the wire. Remove only the known wrapper and parse the enclosed JSON array as data; never execute the response.

KLineBar.title: KLineBar
KLineBar.description: Logical bar object parsed from the JavaScript wrapper. OHLC and volume are serialized as strings. Intraday bars observed at scales 1/5/15/30/60 include amount; daily scale 240 omitted amount in repeated 2026-08-10 checks.

day.description: `YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss` for observed intraday scales, or `YYYY-MM-DD` for scale 240.

amount.description: Observed on intraday bars; absent from the scale-240 sample.

ma_price5.description: Example optional field returned when `ma=5`; the suffix follows the requested moving-average window.

ma_volume5.description: Example optional field returned when `ma=5`; the suffix follows the requested moving-average window.
